source: Synthetic captures drawn with Pillow from text written for this repository: an off-white board with an illumination gradient and noise, marker text in the DejaVu Sans font with a slight wobble and blur, plus lined paper for the notes page. Nothing was photographed. The boards are saved as JPEG at quality 85, as a phone camera would save them. The notes page is saved as PNG.
